title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal: The objectives of this course are to assist students in determining their future progress and facilitating their development as professional engineers. There are two main issues: 1. Performing the necessary self-analysis prior to the start of job hunting and grasping themselves well. 2. Making plans for issues that require relatively long periods of preparation and groundwork such as qualification acquisition and practice exams(SPI test).
advice: The outline of this course is as follows: 1. Guidance/Recommendations to career planning. 2. How to write your selling points and exercises. 3. Encouragement of qualification and self-analysis. 4. Practice exam for employment (SPI). 5. Lecture I: Lecture by specialist from a local company. 6. Lecture II: Lecture by specialist from a local company. 7. Lecture III: Lecture by specialist from a local company. 8. Lecture IV: Lecture by specialist from a local company. 9. Lecture V: Lecture by specialist from a local company. 10. Self-inspection and review of correction results for your own paper "MY SALES POINTS". (Note: Depending on the teacher's circumstances, lectures may be held outside regular class hours. In that case, the class details may be changed.)
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminar I is to be held this year as a course for job hunting activities, and is intended to encourage students to engage in groundwork and preparations for the current difficult employment front. All students are encouraged to take this course, regardless of their advancement or employment opportunities, as part of their job hunting preparations and in preparation for employment examinations. This learning acquired in this course will provide reference material for use when seeking employment next year.

activityGoals.body: Be able to consider deeply the relationship between life design and career path.
Be able to think and act to find the path that suits you.
Be able to explain yourself logically so that others can understand the policies & goals about your career path.
Be able to investigate the knowledge, ability, skills, etc., necessary to achieve the goals for your career.

achievementLevels.ideal: By the end of the course, students should be able to perform the following: ・Consider deeply the relationship between life design and career path. ・Find the path that suits them. ・Explain themselves logically so that others can understand the policies and goals set that are related to their career path, such as going on to school or getting a job. ・Study the knowledge, ability, skills, etc., necessary to achieve the goals for their chosen career, and prepare for and respond to issues autonomously.
achievementLevels.standard: By the end of the course, students should be able to perform the following: ・Consider the relationship between life planning and career path. ・Find the path that suits them. ・Explain to others the policies and goals related to their career path such as going on to school or getting a job. ・Study the knowledge, ability, skills, qualifications, etc., necessary to achieve the goals for their chosen career, and prepare autonomously.
